records.source: Oh! Aren't you the one who just moved in?#$b#I'm Maru. I've been looking forward to meeting you!$h#$e#You know, with a small town like this, a new face can really alter the community dynamic. It's exciting!
records.translation: 喔！你就是剛搬來的那位，對吧？#$b#我是瑪魯。我一直很期待見到你！$h#$e#你知道嗎，在這麼小的鎮上，一張新面孔真的能改變整個社區的氣氛。真令人興奮！

records.source: Heh... sure! Suddenly, the dance sounds a lot more fun.$h
records.translation: 嘿……好啊！這場舞會突然聽起來有趣多了。$h

records.source: Hey, what's this, a birthday gift? It's great! Thanks for remembering me!$h
records.translation: 嘿，這是什麼，生日禮物嗎？太棒了！謝謝你記得我的生日！$h

records.source: Hey, what's this, a birthday gift? It's... uh, well, it's a gift! Thanks for remembering me, anyway.
records.translation: 嘿，這是什麼，生日禮物嗎？這……呃，嗯，確實是份禮物！不管怎樣，謝謝你記得我的生日。

records.source: Mmm... How does it taste so good? This is really a great gift.
records.translation: 嗯……怎麼會這麼好喝？這真是份很棒的禮物。

records.source: This will be perfect for powering my latest project! Thanks, @!$h
records.translation: 這正好能為我最新的專案供應動力！謝謝你，@！$h

records.source: Ah, pure gold... It's not the strongest material, but it has some really useful properties!$h
records.translation: 啊，純金……它雖然不是最堅固的材料，卻有一些非常實用的特性！$h

records.source: Oh, wow! That's a rare element. It's theorized that all the iridium in our world comes from meteorites...$h
records.translation: 喔，哇！那是種稀有元素。理論認為，我們世界裡的銥全都來自隕石……$h

records.source: Ooh, this is exciting! I'll deconstruct it and see if I can reverse-engineer the technology.$h
records.translation: 喔，太令人興奮了！我要把它拆解，看看能不能逆向解析其中的技術。$h

records.source: Ahh! Be careful with that! Are you touching it with your bare hands?$9#$b#... Sorry... hehe... With proper handling, this will be perfect for an exotic machine I'm building.
records.translation: 啊！小心那個！你該不會徒手碰它吧？$9#$b#……抱歉……嘿嘿……只要妥善處理，它就非常適合用在我正在打造的一台奇特機器上。

records.source: Ummm... Don't break the news to my Dad, okay? I'll handle it.
records.translation: 嗯……先別把這件事告訴爸爸，好嗎？我會處理。

records.source: Mmm... I'm having a hard time focusing on my work today.$l
records.translation: 嗯……我今天很難專心工作。$l

records.source: I want to go collect samples with my dad, but my Mom is insisting we stay here...
records.translation: 我想和爸爸一起去採集樣本，但媽媽堅持要我們留在這裡……

records.source: This is a rare opportunity to study a unique phenomenon... every moment counts!
records.translation: 這是研究獨特現象的難得機會……每一刻都很寶貴！

records.source: I should've spent more time on that piece before showing you...$s
records.translation: 我應該再多花點時間完善那件作品，再拿給你看……$s

records.source: How's your hand feeling?#$b#Let me see it... Hey, it looks all better!$h
records.translation: 你的手感覺怎麼樣？#$b#讓我看看……嘿，看起來已經完全好了！$h

records.source: Hey, I guess we're brother and sister now!$h^Hey, I guess we're sisters now!$h#$e#I'm glad that Sebastian found a way out of the basement...#$e#I wish you two all the best!
records.translation: 嘿，看來我們現在是兄妹了！$h^嘿，看來我們現在是姊妹了！$h#$e#很高興賽巴斯汀終於走出了地下室……#$e#祝你們兩個幸福！

records.source: Hey, congratulations!$h#$b#I remember the first time Penny told me she had feelings for you...#$b#She was all shy about it, but I knew right away it was serious... she wouldn't say something like that if she didn't mean it!
records.translation: 嘿，恭喜你們！$h#$b#我還記得潘妮第一次告訴我她對你有感覺……#$b#她說起來非常害羞，但我馬上就知道她是認真的……如果不是真心的，她不會說那種話！

records.source: You always seemed far too healthy to be at the clinic so often... Now it's all starting to make sense...
records.translation: 你看起來一直健康得很，卻那麼常去診所……現在一切都說得通了……

records.source: Willy mentioned that you helped fix the boat. Thanks for doing that!
records.translation: 威利提到你幫忙修好了船。謝謝你！

records.source: That was fun!
records.translation: 真好玩！

records.source: I've been noticing a few different starfish species. My favorite are the big purple ones, but they're all very interesting!
records.translation: 我注意到這裡有好幾種不同的海星。我最喜歡紫色的大海星，不過每一種都很有趣！

records.source: *gasp*... It's a solar eclipse!$3#$b#Oh... never mind. It's just your body blocking the sun.
records.translation: *倒抽一口氣*……日食！$3#$b#喔……沒事。只是你的身體擋住了太陽。

records.source: We're so far removed from civilization out here.#$b#Imagine the stars you could see at night.#$e#Who knows, maybe we'd even see a flying saucer or two!$h
records.translation: 這裡離文明世界好遠。#$b#想像一下，晚上能看到什麼樣的星空。#$e#誰知道呢，也許還能看到一兩艘飛碟！$h

records.source: Mmmm... Why are tropical fruits so good?
records.translation: 嗯……熱帶水果怎麼會這麼好吃？

records.source: I wonder if Willy would let me bring my telescope here sometime...#The sky is so clear here, I bet I could spot Pelican Town out in the horizon.#Maybe I'd even see you running around %farm Farm!
records.translation: 不知道威利會不會讓我哪天把望遠鏡帶來……#這裡的天空如此清澈，我敢說能在地平線上看見鵜鶘鎮。#也許還能看到你在 %farm 農場四處奔跑！

records.source: Of course... *whisper* Then can we go home and snuggle?$l
records.translation: 當然……*低語* 那我們之後可以回家依偎在一起嗎？$l

records.source: I'm flattered! But... No.
records.translation: 你這麼邀請我，我很榮幸！不過……不行。

records.source: We have nothing to say to each other.$a
records.translation: 我們之間沒什麼好說的。$a

records.source: Not good enough for you, huh?$a#$b#Fine...$s
records.translation: 我配不上你，是嗎？$a#$b#好吧……$s

records.source: You've got some nerve, speaking to me!$a
records.translation: 你居然還有臉來和我說話！$a

records.source: You've lost some respect with me, @... but I'm willing to forgive you.$s
records.translation: @，我對你的敬意已經打了折扣……但我願意原諒你。$s

records.source: Whenever I'm struggling with a technical problem, I always take a walk.#$e#It's surprising how much a change of scenery can help.
records.translation: 每當技術問題讓我陷入困境，我總會出去走走。#$e#換個環境能帶來多大的幫助，實在令人驚訝。

records.source: Have you met my mother? She's the town's carpenter.
records.translation: 你見過我媽媽嗎？她是鎮上的木匠。

records.source: On Tuesdays and Thursdays I work at Harvey's clinic.#$b#He says he likes having me around in case his medical equipment goes haywire!$h#$e#Being a farmer must be pretty easy, huh?
records.translation: 每逢星期二和星期四，我都會去哈維的診所工作。#$b#他說很高興有我在身邊，以防醫療設備突然故障！$h#$e#當農夫一定很輕鬆，對吧？

records.source: I plan on spending a lot of time with my telescope this summer.
records.translation: 今年夏天，我打算花很多時間使用望遠鏡。

records.source: Sometimes, when I'm looking into space with my telescope, I get struck with this eerie feeling... Like we aren't meant to see this.#$e#It's silly, I know...$h
records.translation: 有時透過望遠鏡凝望太空，會有一種詭異的感覺突然襲來……彷彿我們不該看見這一切。#$e#我知道這很傻……$h

records.source: Do you know my Dad, Demetrius? He's a scientist. I have a lot of fun helping him out in the laboratory.
records.translation: 你認識我爸爸德米特里厄斯嗎？他是科學家。在實驗室幫他做事很有趣。

records.source: It's really satisfying when you can repair something yourself, instead of just throwing it away.
records.translation: 能親手修好東西，而不是直接丟掉，真的很有成就感。

records.source: Some people say 'magic isn't real'... but have they ever stopped and really thought about magnetism?
records.translation: 有些人說「魔法並不存在」……但他們有沒有停下來，認真思考過磁力？

records.source: If you think about the human body, it's hard to believe that somehow, it all just 'works'.
records.translation: 仔細想想人體，就很難相信這一切竟然自然而然地「運作」著。

records.source: You know, I was thinking... even with all the technology in the world, nothing beats having a real human friend.
records.translation: 你知道嗎，我在想……即使擁有世上所有的科技，也沒有什麼比得上一位真正的人類朋友。

records.source: Hey, sorry if I seem cranky... I'm a little sore from work yesterday.#$c .5# I had to carry ten boxes of medical files to the attic!#$e#I had to sort patient records for four hours straight!
records.translation: 嘿，如果我看起來脾氣不好，抱歉……昨天工作後身體有點痠痛。#$c .5# 我得把十箱病歷搬上閣樓！#$e#我連續整理了四個小時的病患紀錄！

records.source: Hi!#$q 3/4 Sun_01_old#Do you have fun working on the farm?#$r 3 0 Sun_01_01#Yes.#$r 4 0 Sun_01_02#No.
records.translation: 嗨！#$q 3/4 Sun_01_old#在農場工作開心嗎？#$r 3 0 Sun_01_01#開心。#$r 4 0 Sun_01_02#不開心。

records.source: $p 3#Hey, you've made another week of progress on the farm! It seems like things are going well for you.$h|Another tiring week on the farm, huh? It must really be a lot of work...$s
records.translation: $p 3#嘿，你的農場又向前邁進了一週！看來一切都很順利。$h|又在農場辛苦了一週，對吧？工作量一定真的很大……$s

records.source: Well that's good, isn't it?$h
records.translation: 那很好，不是嗎？$h

records.source: Yikes! I'm sorry. Have you ever thought of doing something different...?$s
records.translation: 哎呀！抱歉。你有沒有想過改做別的事……？$s

records.source: Stop by our house when you need to upgrade your buildings.#$e#It's always nice to have visitors.
records.translation: 需要升級建築時，就來我們家吧。#$e#有人來訪總是很開心。

records.source: My mother is a carpenter and my dad is a scientist. I guess it makes sense that I'm into building gadgets.
records.translation: 媽媽是木匠，爸爸是科學家。難怪我會喜歡打造各種裝置。

records.source: My Dad is very logical, and my Mom is very intuitive. That difference leads to conflict, sometimes...$s
records.translation: 爸爸非常理性，媽媽則非常重視直覺。這種差異有時會引發衝突……$s

records.source: Sometimes my head gets so cluttered with nonsense I can hardly think. Does that ever happen to you?#$e#Getting some fresh air usually helps.
records.translation: 有時腦袋被雜念塞得滿滿的，幾乎無法思考。你也有過這種情況嗎？#$e#出去呼吸新鮮空氣通常會有幫助。

records.source: I'm glad to have a job at the clinic... I feel like I'm helping people in town.#$e#Dr. Harvey? He's nice, but not really my type...
records.translation: 很高興能在診所工作……這讓我覺得自己正在幫助鎮上的人。#$e#哈維醫生？他人很好，但不太是我喜歡的類型……

records.source: Oh, @! Is there anything you want to talk to me about?$l
records.translation: 喔，@！有什麼想和我聊的嗎？$l

records.source: Of course he'll know the difference! This sample is completely ruined!%fork$s
records.translation: 他當然看得出差別！這份樣本徹底毀了！%fork$s

records.source: Okay. I'll blame it on you, then.$u
records.translation: 好吧。那我就怪到你頭上。$u

records.source: You're right. I should just tell him the truth.%fork$u
records.translation: 你說得對。我應該直接告訴他實話。%fork$u
